questions.question: When Nahash the Ammonite surrounded the town of Jabesh-gilead, what did the men of Jabesh offer him?

answers.text: To serve him under a treaty
To give him the town and leave

questions.question: When Saul heard that Nahash the Ammonite threatened the people of Jabesh, what rushed upon him?
Saul cut a pair of oxen into pieces and sent them through Israel. What message went with them?

answers.text: March behind Saul and Samuel or else
Pay the new king's tax or else
Send your oxen to Gibeah or else

questions.question: After Israel defeated the Ammonites, Saul refused to let anyone be put to death. Who did he say had saved Israel that day?
